name: brega-system-tests
description: Firestore rules tests (emulator) and browser tests (Playwright) for the Brega sales system

scripts.rules: cp ../firestore.rules ./firestore.rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-brega "node rules/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.browser: node browser/xss.js && ROLE=w node browser/xss.js && node browser/auth.js && node browser/pwa.js && node browser/palette.js && node browser/govern.js && node browser/polish.js && node browser/offline.js && node browser/sms055.js && node browser/home.js && node browser/meetnotify.js && node browser/filescope.js && node browser/csp.js && node browser/auditlog.js && node browser/powerbi.js
